findings.title: No test for empty list or conversations without a last message
findings.failure_scenario: The sort in ConversationListFeature.swift:45-47 falls back to `.distantPast` when lastMessage is nil. Every test seeds ChatSeed data, where each conversation has messages (expected() even force-unwraps `last[id]!`). So if the fallback became `.distantFuture`, a conversation with no messages would jump to the top of the list and all three tests would still pass. An empty fetch result going to status .loaded with no conversations is also never exercised.
findings.evidence: ConversationListFeature.swift:46 `($0.lastMessage?.sentAt ?? .distantPast) > ($1.lastMessage?.sentAt ?? .distantPast)`. In ConversationListFeatureTests.swift, seeded() at lines 22-25 always uses ChatSeed.conversations and ChatSeed.messages. expected() at line 35 does `conversation.lastMessage = last[id]!`, which assumes every seeded conversation has a message. No test builds an InMemoryChat with an empty list or with a conversation that has no messages.
findings.fix: Add a test with a conversation that has no messages and a test with an empty fetch result. Assert the nil-last-message conversation sorts last and that the empty result gives status .loaded.
findings.verification_note: I read the reducer and all three tests in the worktree. Every test uses seeded(), which is backed only by ChatSeed, and expected() force-unwraps the last message for each id, so the seed has no conversation without messages. That means the nil fallback branch of the sort comparator never runs, and swapping .distantPast for .distantFuture would not fail any test. The empty-result path is also untested. The PLAN acceptance only lists success order, failure and retry, so this is a coverage gap, not a runtime defect. There is no user-visible harm today, so I rated it no-harm-yet at minor. I cited line 22 (the seeded() helper, the only data source) because the finding gave no line.

notes:
ConversationListFeature: .task and .retryButtonTapped set status .loading and call chatClient.fetchConversations; non-ChatError errors map to .server. Success sorts by lastMessage.sentAt descending (nil last) and sets .loaded. Failure sets .failed(error) and logs .error, category "conversationList". conversationTapped is a no-op. ConversationListView uses AccessibilityID.List ids; loading spinner and error/"Try again" sit in safeAreaInset(.top); view sends .task on appear. LaunchFlowUITests waits for conversationList.row.0.name == "Ada Lovelace". TimedBuildStarter UI test is only built at slice, not run. The plan lists no test- ids, so testsAdded is empty (3 tests in ConversationListFeatureTests).
